title: PBKDF2 with salt_len=0 is accepted — SP 800-132 violation
description: ioctl_do_kdf permits salt_len=0 for pbkdf2(*) algos. SP 800-132 §5.1 requires salt length >= 128 bits (16 bytes) for password-based KDFs. FIPS 140-3 audit will flag this as a compliance gap. The current UAPI doc says 'Set salt_len = 0 for no salt' without distinguishing HKDF (where 0-salt is RFC 5869-legal) from PBKDF2 (where it is not). Maintenance consequence: a FIPS tester will file this as a finding against the module; it will need to be fixed under time pressure. Fix: reject salt_len < 16 when op.algo starts with 'pbkdf2', with -EINVAL and a comment citing SP 800-132 §5.1.
